title: Dubiousness
summary: DUBIOUSNESS, noun 1. Doubtfulness; a state of wavering and indecision of mind; as, he speaks with dubiousness 2. Uncertainty; as the dubiousness of the question.

inlines.v: DUBIOUSNESS, noun 1. Doubtfulness; a state of wavering and indecision of mind; as, he speaks with dubiousness 2. Uncertainty; as the dubiousness of the question.
